description: This file defines the implementation of a PDxCH baseband processor class, including its configuration, constructor, and key methods for connecting, stopping, and handling modulation and frequency control. It manages modulators, buffers, and interactions with other components in the physical layer of a communication system.

classes.name: pdxch_processor_impl
classes.description: Implements a physical downlink channel baseband processor handling modulation, buffer management, and frequency control within the ocudu namespace.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a notifier to the processor to handle transmission events.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Signals the processor to stop accepting new transmissions and waits for ongoing tasks to complete.

methods.name: get_request_handler
methods.description: Returns a reference to the request handler component.

methods.name: get_baseband
methods.description: Returns a reference to the baseband processor component.

methods.name: get_center_freq_control
methods.description: Returns a reference to the frequency control component.

methods.name: process_slot
methods.description: Processes a given slot context, producing modulation results.

methods.name: handle_request
methods.description: Handles resource grid requests for downlink transmission.

methods.name: set_carrier_center_frequency
methods.description: Sets the carrier center frequency in Hz.

methods.name: on_modulation_completion
methods.description: Callback invoked upon modulation completion for a slot.
